{"code": "print('Conversion rates by channel, stratified by customer_segment:')

# Compute conversion rates within each segment
stratified_rates = (sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index())
print(stratified_rates)

# Compute overall conversion rates by channel, adjusting for segment
# Weighted average by segment size
channel_segment_counts = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
channel_total_counts = channel_segment_counts.sum(axis=1)

# Weighted average conversion rate per channel
weighted_rates = []
for channel in channel_segment_counts.index:
    weights = channel_segment_counts.loc[channel] / channel_total_counts[channel]
    weighted_rate = (stratified_rates[stratified_rates['channel'] == channel]['converted'] * weights).sum()
    weighted_rates.append(weighted_rate)

print('\nWeighted conversion rates (adjusted for segment):')
for channel, rate in zip(channel_segment_counts.index, weighted_rates):
    print(f'{channel}: {rate:.4f}')"}
